Results.OriginalProductName: 52 cc Gas 2-Stroke 2-in-1 Brush Cutter and String Hand Held Trimmer
Results.ReviewText:
The 52cc engine starts easily and has plenty of power to cut through dense brush. I've used a 4 tooth brush blade but have changed over to an 80 carbide tooth, 10" blade which cuts anything in it's path up to 3 1/2" trees. I've also used the string trimmer head and that works well including the auto-feed mechanism.

It is a heavy tool, but the harness supports all the weight on your shoulders allowing your arms to control the blade very efficiently. 

The engine is not very efficient, going through fuel at about twice the pace of my much higher cost Stihl brush cutter. Also the plastic on the blade and engine guards is fairly light and flimsy and I expect they will fail prematurely. A few rock hits have already weakened the blade guard. I've now run it for about 12 hour over a couple of weeks and it's performing very well. For the price, it's a very strong performer. I hope it lasts a year or two.

It snapped in half the second day of using it.  I can still actuate the choke but there is just a little nub left of the lever.  I bought the badger for price and learned the hard way that you get what you pay for.  Next time I will spend the extra money to get a higher quality product.

311424784.Description: The Wild Badger Power 2-in-1 Straight Shaft Grass String Trimmer and Brush Cutter is a versatile, powerful tool. This multi-tool has a grass trimmer spool for detail work along fence lines and borders, as well as a brush cutter blade to tackle heavier grasses and thick brush. It also includes a harness coupled with ergonomic bicycle-style handles to relieve the strain on your arms and provide stability. Powered by a 52cc, 2-cycle, full-crank engine, your trimmer has plenty of power and is designed for reliability. The full crank design provides a smooth start and operation to reduce emissions, increase fuel efficiency and provide longer life. The transmission is supported by an aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube which is lightweight and durable for added comfort and convenience. The tap-and-go trimmer head allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawns and landscaping looking clean. Notes about the product: This machine takes a mix of both gasoline and oil, other attachments and accessories not included.
